name: MonarchAiKnowledgeScope
title: AiKnowledgeScope
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.TriStateCheckbox in rows with androidx.compose.foundation.selection.triStateToggleable, in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
summary: A tree of spaces, documents and apps with checkboxes, where a person picks what grounds the assistant's answers.
whenToUse: In an assistant's settings or composer, to let people limit the answers to chosen spaces, documents and connected apps.
whenNotToUse: For a flat list of options, use MonarchCheckboxGroup. To browse a hierarchy and open items, use MonarchTreeView. To connect new apps, use MonarchAiConnectorPicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiKnowledgeScope(sources: List<MonarchAiKnowledgeSource>, selection: List<String>, onSelectionChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, expandIcon: @Composable () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, initiallyExpanded: Set<String> = emptySet(), showSummary: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels = MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels())

class MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(id: String, label: String, kind: MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind, description: String? = null, children: List<MonarchAiKnowledgeSource> = emptyList()) { val isGroup: Boolean }
enum class MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind { Space, Document, App }

class MonarchAiKnowledgeScopeLabels(label: String? = null, kind: ((MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind) -> String)? = null, itemLabel: ((label: String, kind: String) -> String)? = null, summary: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, empty: String? = null, expand: ((label: String) -> String)? = null, collapse: ((label: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: sources
options.description: The sources as a tree: each has an id, a label, a kind (space, document, app), an optional description and optional children.

options.name: selection
options.description: The ids of the selected sources. A group's id stands for everything in it.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called after every toggle with every fully selected source, groups included, in tree order; ids that are not in the tree are kept at the end.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: A chevron that points to the end, such as a MonarchIcon of size Sm with mirrorInRtl. It turns a quarter turn while a group is open. Required because Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: enabled
options.description: false makes every checkbox impossible to change; groups can still be opened.

options.name: initiallyExpanded
options.description: The ids of the groups that start open. Later opening and closing is kept across configuration changes.

options.name: showSummary
options.description: Shows "3 sources selected" under the tree. A fully selected group counts as one.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Knowledge sources", the kind names, "Handbook, Space", the summary, "No sources available" and "Show contents of" / "Hide contents of" (strings_aiknowledgescope.xml).

states.name: unchecked
states.description: An empty checkbox. Checking it selects the source and everything in it.

states.name: checked
states.description: A ticked checkbox. Checking it again clears the source and everything in it.

states.name: mixed
states.description: A group with some of its contents selected shows the Material 3 indeterminate box with a dash. Checking it clears the group.

states.name: expanded
states.description: The chevron turns a quarter turn and the group's contents follow, indented one level.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false the checkboxes and texts take the disabled roles and cannot change; groups can still be opened.

states.name: empty
states.description: No sources: a small MonarchEmptyState reading "No sources available".

appearance: Material 3 checkboxes in the Monarch theme (accent fill when checked or mixed) beside the source name in default text and the kind and description in muted caption text; the chevron is muted text. Disabled rows use the disabled text role. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web builds an ARIA tree with a roving focus and arrow keys; Android uses checkbox rows in a column, so TalkBack, Switch Access and a hardware keyboard move through them like any controls, and a group's disclosure is a separate button. The row also offers TalkBack's expand and collapse actions. Level, set size and position are not spoken. MonarchTreeView is not reused: it has single and multiple selection but no tri-state checkboxes, and it is a lazy list that cannot sit in a scrolling screen. The web's controlled expanded and onExpandedChange are not offered; initiallyExpanded sets the first state, as iOS's startsExpanded. The web announces the summary politely; Android shows it as text and lets each checkbox speak its new state, as iOS does. The chevron is a required slot because Monarch bundles no icons.
accessibility: The tree is a traversal group named "Knowledge sources".
Each source is one element with the checkbox role, named "Handbook, Space" followed by its description, read as checked, not checked or partially checked.
A partly selected group is a tri-state checkbox in the indeterminate state, so the state is spoken, not only drawn as a dash.
Each group has a disclosure button named "Show contents of Handbook" or "Hide contents of Handbook", and its row offers the expand and collapse actions.
Every row and disclosure button has a 48dp touch target; names and descriptions wrap at font scale 2.0.
The chevron turns the other way in right-to-left layouts so it points down when open, and the disclosure button sits at the start edge.
edgeCases: A group with every child selected counts as selected, and its id is added to the selection.
Ids in the selection that are not in the tree are kept, at the end, so a source that is temporarily missing is not lost.
The tree is not lazy; for hundreds of sources offer a search instead.
An empty children list is a single source, not an empty group.

examples.title: Choose sources
examples.template:
MonarchAiKnowledgeScope(
    sources = sources,
    selection = selection,
    onSelectionChange = { selection = it },
    initiallyExpanded = setOf({{expanded.0}}),
)

val kind = { raw: String -> MonarchAiKnowledgeSourceKind.entries.first { it.name.lowercase().startsWith(raw) } }
val sources = listOf(
    MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
        id = {{sources.0.id}},
        label = {{sources.0.label}},
        kind = kind({{sources.0.kind}}),
        description = {{sources.0.description}},
        children = listOf(
            MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                id = {{sources.0.children.0.id}},
                label = {{sources.0.children.0.label}},
                kind = kind({{sources.0.children.0.kind}})
            ),
            MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                id = {{sources.0.children.1.id}},
                label = {{sources.0.children.1.label}},
                kind = kind({{sources.0.children.1.kind}})
            ),
            MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                id = {{sources.0.children.2.id}},
                label = {{sources.0.children.2.label}},
                kind = kind({{sources.0.children.2.kind}})
            ),
        )
    ),
    MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
        id = {{sources.1.id}},
        label = {{sources.1.label}},
        kind = kind({{sources.1.kind}}),
        children = listOf(
            MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
                id = {{sources.1.children.0.id}},
                label = {{sources.1.children.0.label}},
                kind = kind({{sources.1.children.0.kind}})
            ),
            MonarchAiKnowledgeSource(
